prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Input image 1: authoritative geometry, construction, color and viewpoint reference for the actual conveyor belt electric knife.
Primary request: Recreate ONLY the complete foreground belt cutting tool shown in the reference as a clean realistic CAD-style 3D product model isolated on a genuinely transparent background with alpha. This is NOT a circular saw. Preserve the exact overall silhouette, proportions, perspective and every major mechanical assembly visible in the photograph: the large cobalt-blue bolted plate housing covering most of the circular blade at lower left, blue long horizontal base with row of silver bolts, projecting feed roller shaft at bottom left, partly exposed smooth steel cutting disc under the housing, black auxiliary cylindrical handle projecting toward the viewer at upper left, the long black front drive assembly attached diagonally to the blue cutter housing, the dark teal and black Metabo cordless drive at upper right with its rear loop handle, red trigger and red-black battery underneath. Keep tool brand lettering as in reference without adding new lettering. Preserve real hardware and connections; don't invent a motor, saw-toothed disc, cable or alternate grip. Remove ALL workshop background, workbench, spare gearbox housings at left, hanging tools, plastic bags and loose objects. Clean uniform studio illumination and polished materials, like a precision 3D equipment catalog render rather than a raw photo cutout. Retain faithful colors blue metal, teal/black plastic, red controls, silver hardware. Same three-quarter side viewpoint as reference, entire complete tool visible, landscape 3:2 composition, centered with about 8 percent empty transparent margins. No floor plane, no opaque white fill, no fake checkerboard drawn into image, no watermark, no extra items. Transparency must be genuine.
